name: Orb of Construct Control (Major Artifact)
body:
Slot none; CL 20th; Weight 5 lbs.; Aura strong transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This artifact is somehow similar to an orb of dragonkind, but it bestows power over all kinds of constructs instead.

The bearer of the orb can, as a standard action, dominate all constructs and animated objects within 500 feet (as control constructUM). A character possessing an orb of construct control is immune to all the special powers of the controlled constructs. The owner of an orb knows whether there are constructs within 10 miles at all times. If within 1 mile, the wielder can determine the construct’s exact location and type. The wielder can at any time sense and speak through a controlled construct, as enter image. Once per day, the wielder can also enter the body of a controlled construct, speaking and acting through it. This works as possess objectUM, except that the bearer’s body is completely absorbed into the construct, and not left behind. The bearer can speak and cast spells through the possessed construct’s body, but if it is destroyed, the bearer dies. Lastly, the orb’s wielder can cast animate objects once per round at level 12th.

DESTRUCTION

An orb of construct control is destroyed if touched by a tear shed by a construct or an animated object. This causes an explosion dealing 20d6 force damage to everyone within 90 feet (DC 30 Ref save for half damage).
